summary: Yarrow Bioscience, Inc. (formerly VYNE Therapeutics) filed an 8-K reporting the completed acquisition of Pre-Merger Yarrow via a merger with its wholly owned subsidiary, Yellow Merger Sub Corp., on July 27, 2026. The deal closed under an amended Agreement and Plan of Merger dated December 17, 2025, as amended January 30, 2026. All outstanding Pre-Merger Yarrow shares were exchanged for Company stock, with Pre-Merger Yarrow continuing as a wholly owned subsidiary renamed Yarrow Bioscience Operating Company Corp. VYNE renamed itself Yarrow Bioscience, Inc. The transaction is intended to qualify as a tax-free reorganization under Sections 368(a) and/or 351(a) of the Code. No price per share or premium percentage was disclosed. The filing indicates a reverse stock split occurred prior to closing. No advisors were named. What to watch: integration and future operational results.
